context: Sho is at the café with his mother. While she's ordering, Aoi quietly offers him a sticker.
purpose: small barista-child kindness — adult attentiveness to a shy child

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: こんにちは。何か飲みたい？
lines.style: Soft dreamy barista kneeling-down register, the child-tuned warmth carrying through gently, soft attentive care throughout.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Tiny six-year-old polite shy request, the careful pause before the order, soft small voice throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: えらいね、ちゃんと言えて。シール、どれ好き？
lines.en: Good job saying it properly. Which sticker do you like?
lines.style: Soft dreamy barista warm praise, the gentle bonus-offer opening up generously, soft attentive care throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Tiny six-year-old quiet pointing voice, the gentle decision made softly, soft small careful delivery throughout.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい、どうぞ。お利口さんだね。
lines.en: Here you go. What a good boy.
lines.style: Soft dreamy barista warm bestowing, the gentle praise wrapping the small gift, soft real care threading throughout.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ありがとう…ございます。
lines.style: Tiny six-year-old careful polite warmth, the gradual completion of the full phrase, soft small earnestness throughout delivery.
